title: Email Classification
description: An enterprise AI workflow that classifies emails using their content, metadata, and attachments to automate case routing, information extraction, and business processes. Improved classification accuracy from 55% to 95% through prompt engineering and LLM optimization.

title: Knowledge Management Tool
description: A scalable knowledge management and collaboration platform with Django REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, asynchronous task processing, and comprehensive API documentation for enterprise teams.

title: SaaS Ideator
description: An AI-powered SaaS planning platform that helps founders validate product ideas through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, document indexing, and web knowledge analysis.

title: KOSH
description: An AI model evaluation framework for benchmarking multiple Large Language Models using quantitative metrics, confusion matrix analysis, and business-focused evaluation pipelines to support production model selection.

title: Backendifyi
description: A Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that enables developers to integrate authentication, APIs, database management, and essential backend capabilities without building a dedicated backend.

title: MedConnect
description: A telemedicine platform enabling secure doctor-patient video consultations, appointment scheduling, slot management, online payments, and automated payouts through an integrated healthcare workflow.

title: DelMax
description: A courier delivery optimization platform that analyzes delivery data, optimizes routes using Google Maps APIs, and visualizes deliveries through an interactive mapping interface.
award: 🥇 1st Runner Up • HackOverflow by NIT Meghalaya

title: ChartBay
description: A data visualization platform that generates interactive charts from manual input or CSV files, with support for exporting reports as PNG and PDF and sharing them instantly.
award: 🥈 2nd Runner Up • Sparkathon by NMIMS Navi Mumbai

title: VacciFast
description: A vaccination slot booking and management platform featuring intelligent slot allocation based on regional demand, Google Maps integration, and automated email notifications.

title: ProjectsBay
description: A platform that enables developers and students to showcase, organize, and share software projects through customizable public project profiles.

title: StudentsBay
description: An academic communication platform that centralizes announcements, email notifications, grievance management, and searchable discussions for educational institutions.
